description: Given a list of integers a with at least 8 elements, return a new list of the same length that equals a except that the element at index 4 is increased by 3 and the element at index 7 is replaced by 516. Indices start at 0.
notes: VERINA's Lean postcondition reads result[i]! (with a default value for out-of-range indices) and does not state the length of the result. Both specs add len(result) == len(a), which is implied by the task (only two positions change) and is needed for the indexing to be well defined.
